# Pinned:  5b28bf51  — KISS main head when re-vendored (the #536 merge), 2026-10-11. The seed gained
#          a second block (the TOKEN SET, 13 rows) beside the dispatch set; the previous pin
# src/manifest.rs) compares this crate's manifest members to the rows below BY KEY
# (token, class, sm_number). Pinned, NOT live: a gate reading KISS's `main` at test
# time would red on KISS's unrelated edits and couple this crate's CI to KISS's
# availability, trading a drift problem for a flakiness one.
# ⚠ BUMPING THE PIN IS A DELIBERATE ACT, and the pin has NO automatic liveness
# signal: neither the freshness gate nor the semantic gate reds when THIS snapshot
# is stale, because they measure AGAINST it — a stale pin is invisible to them by
# construction (a vendored copy is a fork the moment its currency stops being
# checked; this header is what keeps it a copy). To check whether the pin is behind
# If the seed changed: re-vendor the rows here, update the `Pinned:` line to the new
# KISS commit + date, and re-run the semantic gate (it will agree or point at the
# real disagreement). A choice, deliberately taken — not an event that breaks CI.
# Two tab-separated blocks, vendored verbatim from the appendix's two ```tsv fences.
# Rows are told apart by their first column: a `cuda:` token (token set) or an
# `ArchSku` variant `Sm…` (dispatch set); `#` lines and the two header rows
# (`token…`, `sku…`) are skipped. The gate parses whitespace-tolerantly.
# TOKEN SET — every `cuda:` token the maintainer supports, whichever component serves it.
